name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses match the task requirements. 'Reach the exit' is captured by Existence(at_exit) hard. 'Pick up immediately after fall' is captured by ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard. 'Have box at exit' is captured by Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard. Clauses are not redundant and respect environment constraints.

texts: Pick up the box immediately after it falls.
Have the box in your hands when reaching the exit.
